from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,signal
NAME='diag_current_test_selected_01'
REFS=[
 ('t01v2_checkpoint_test_a_full_01','98a6f19079edfda4bdcd52d6ec213bce3755b062af4aa24dcec672eabd7e51b0'),
 ('t01v2_checkpoint_test_b_full_01','d4e2ffacaabc11f30130539d77e51ff2dc69b44ba9db9f49c3c13af54cdfa048'),
 ('t01v2_checkpoint_test_s16_s01_01','c8b2a178ea54e1ca9b9aaa23f4e1d9348e54eb9b2fbaa61b13eab665fa7febde'),
 ('t01v2_checkpoint_test_s16_s02_01','dacca53bdb1222a5b64d6071a9b4860de0148d0b99e1d511d0f4dd1ef0633a2a'),
 ('t01v2_checkpoint_test_s16_s03_01','18fcf0a4a09b14b864a2ed001716fd1ef467418736ddf3a85ebde0c5ef673e9d')]
def main():
 if os.environ.get('CVPR_RUN_NAME')!=NAME:raise ValueError('Require original logged diagnostic identity')
 from src.tools.g01_quota_plan import reconstruct_test_inventory,RECEIPT_AUTHORITY
 refs=[{'file':'results/'+name+'.json','sha256':sha} for name,sha in REFS]
 proof=reconstruct_test_inventory(refs,configuration=True,authority=RECEIPT_AUTHORITY)
 selected=proof['configuration_selection']['selected']
 counts=proof['confirmed_by_kind']
 scenes={kind:sorted({r['scene'] for r in selected if r['kind']==kind}) for kind in counts}
 # A small Direct table is preferred for the single-format-equivalence smoke;
 # this chooses from the original seed-selected inventory, never a duplicate.
 candidate=next((r for r in selected if r['kind']=='direct_stay'),selected[0])
 pairref=candidate['pair_reference'];body=Path(pairref['file']).read_bytes()
 if hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()!=pairref['sha256']:raise ValueError('Selected pair bytes changed')
 pair=json.loads(body)
 if pair['status']!='passed' or pair['scene']!=candidate['scene'] or pair['kind']!=candidate['kind']:
  raise ValueError('Selected construction receipt differs')
 smoke={'source':{k:candidate['checkpoint_reference'][k] for k in ('file','sha256')},
  'pair':pairref,'pair_id':pair['pair_id'],'original_id':pair['pair_id'],'scene':candidate['scene'],
  'kind':candidate['kind'],'field_of_view':60,'proposal_identity':candidate['proposal_identity'],
  'configuration':candidate['configuration'],'original_scene_source':candidate['source_reference'],
  'scope':'Actually selected by the original configuration selector in this fixed cutoff; independent construction PASS only, T02 and lossless dual-format smoke still required'}
 specs=[]
 for fn,sha in [('tasks/T03.md','efad37124e82883bb8b06a2a883142c08aa494d6949bc7145ba83df74f73da63'),
                ('tasks/T02.md','850e034777d5a868504d5e0b9329f9628c17516b3504561fe4cc8e146a7f5562')]:
  if hashlib.sha256(Path(fn).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=sha:raise ValueError('Task specification changed')
  specs.append({'file':fn,'sha256':sha})
 report={'proof':proof,'counts_by_kind':counts,'scenes_by_kind':scenes,
  'scene_counts_by_kind':{k:len(v) for k,v in scenes.items()},'selected_count':len(selected),
  'smoke_candidate':smoke,'specifications':specs,
  'scope':'Current incremental pre-T02 export selection, not a final frozen evaluation set or training/pilot population. Original published independent construction receipts and original seed0 per-configuration/class selector only; no native revalidation performed.',
  'excluded':'Unsealed S04, all smoke sources, all train/pilot sources, and later unreviewed outputs',
  'freeze_rule':'T03: 2026-11-11 20:00 America/New_York, or all four classes reach50; final T02 filtering/balance and committed manifest required before evaluation. This snapshot does not freeze or authorize evaluation.'}
 out=Path('logs/review')/NAME;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
 b=(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode();(out/'report.json').write_bytes(b)
 lines=['当前测试配置去重选中清单（构造独立通过，T02前增量；非最终冻结）','',
 '| 类别 | 当前配置数 | 场景数 |','|---|---:|---:|']
 lines += ['| %s | %d | %d |'%(k,counts[k],len(scenes[k])) for k in counts]
 lines += ['',report['scope'],report['freeze_rule'],'',
  '单pair双格式冒烟候选：%s / %s / %s，精确checkpoint、原pair、配置与proposal引用见report.json。'%(smoke['scene'],smoke['pair_id'],smoke['kind'])]
 (out/'report.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
 print('CURRENT_TEST_SELECTED_JSON: '+json.dumps({'report':{'file':str(out/'report.json'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()},
  'counts_by_kind':counts,'scene_counts_by_kind':report['scene_counts_by_kind'],'selected_count':len(selected),'smoke_candidate':smoke},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
